clips.title: The story
paras: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal is an arcane volume documenting the investigations of the master mage of the Tower of Azora. Delivered to the scholars of the Ironforge Library, the journal adds valuable magical insights to the great dwarven archive.

Archmage Theocritus is known throughout the Alliance as an esteemed spellcaster stationed at the Tower of Azora in the eastern reaches of Elwynn Forest. Over years of solitary study, Theocritus has investigated curious artifacts, ley line anomalies, and nearby magical threats, recording his findings within detailed journals. Recovering such a volume represents a rare opportunity to study the personal observations of a senior Kirin Tor archmage.

The Explorers' League and the caretakers of the Ironforge Library maintain one of the greatest archival repositories on the continent. By delivering Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal to their care, adventurers ensure that its arcane insights are safely preserved and cataloged alongside the historic volumes of Khaz Modan. The librarians actively welcome any further magical discoveries that can broaden their collective wisdom.
